topPRs.title: sep/126: GIWA Sepolia U21 upgrade (OPCMUpgradeV900)
topPRs.author: ihooni
topPRs.body:
## Summary

Adds the GIWA Sepolia Testnet (chain id 91342) Upgrade 21 task (`op-contracts/v9.0.0`, `OPCMUpgradeV900`). GIWA Sepolia is permissioned-only and stays on SUPER_PERMISSIONED (5) with SUPER_CANNON_KONA (9) disabled. Its portal has no ETHLockbox at v8, so the upgrade deploys one and moves the portal's ETH into it. This is the same shape as sepolia-devnet-3 in sep/122.

- Root: the GIWA Sepolia ProxyAdminOwner `0x0B266965c88C78f17e1F9f59784249bf8Da1CB9E`, a nested 2-of-2 of `DunamuUpgradeSafe` `0x3d58…2DB7` and `GIWASecurityCouncil` `0x37FF…bf1C`, each 1-of-1. Both child Safes are named in the task's `[addresses]`.
- Calls, through OPCM `0x160f0fe4dc1b3f4026687e8dd4b7f800879939cc` (9.0.3):
  1. `OPCM.upgradeSuperchain` on GIWA's own SuperchainConfig `0xEF3a…032d` (→ 2.5.0).
  2. `OPCM.upgrade` (`startingRespectedGameType = 5`, `initBond = 0`).
- ETHLockbox: deployed at `0x7E3eFCDC2CccfA6aC0DBD29Da74003C693cd2CbC`, the portal is authorized on it, `ETH_LOCKBOX` is enabled, and the portal's whole balance moves in the same transaction (130,190.007972444890200481 ETH at simulation time).
- `expectedValidationErrors` is `OVERRIDES-L1PAOMULTISIG,SYSCON-130,SCKDG-SHAPE,SCKDG-10`. The codes come from GIWA's own ProxyAdminOwner and SuperchainConfig and the missing SUPER_CANNON_KONA game. It matches sep/122 devnet-3. Unlike U20 (sep/124), there is no `OVERRIDES-CHALLENGER`.
- `cannonKonaPrestate` is the kona-client/v1.9.0 `cannon64-kona-interop` value from `standard-prestates.toml`, as listed on the Upgrade 21 notice. It is never encoded for this chain: the Safe hashes are identical with a different prestate.

---

## For Task PRs

**Task path**: `src/tasks/sep/126-U21-giwa-sepolia`

**Tenderly simulation link**: https://www.tdly.co/shared/simulation/b9bc36cc-ca46-4c31-a11c-100407777052

### Simulation Checklist

> These boxes must be checked before your PR can be merged.

- [x] I have run a Tenderly simulation for this task
- [x] I have reviewed and understand all state changes in the simulation
- [x] I have verified that every state change reflects the **exact expected value** (e.g., if setting an `absolutePrestate`, confirm the precise `bytes32` hash matches expectations)
- [x] All state changes match the expected behavior documented in `VALIDATION.md`
- [x] I can explain every state diff to reviewers and signers

### Task Checklist

- [x] `README.md` is complete with accurate task description
- [x] `VALIDATION.md` documents expected state changes with correct domain/message hashes
- [x] Task status is set appropriately
- [x] All TODOs in generated files have been addressed

---

## Additional context

Validation so far, besides `just simulate` / `just simulate-stack` on both child Safes. Both pass on current `main` (e82ad989) with the same hashes as VALIDATION.md.

- **Independent hashes.** I recomputed the root and both child safe tx hashes with `getTransactionHash` from the task calldata, outside the task tooling:
  - Root: `Multicall3DelegateCall`, delegatecall, nonce 14.
  - Child: `Multicall3.aggregate3Value([approveHash])`, delegatecall, nonces 2 / 3.
  - All three match.
- **Sepolia fork run.** On a Sepolia fork at block 12195000, both child `execTransaction`s (approveHash) and then the root `execTransaction` succeeded. Afterwards:
  - All six versions match.
  - The ETHLockbox sits at the expected address, holds the portal's entire pre-upgrade balance, and the portal balance is 0.
  - The portal is authorized on the ETHLockbox.
  - The ETHLockbox is the pause identifier of the `AnchorStateRegistry` and the `DelayedWETH`.
  - `retirementTimestamp` and the anchor are unchanged.
- **Post-upgrade behaviour on the fork.**
  - The DisputeGameFactory is untouched. The registry proposer can still create a game type 5 game right after the upgrade, and it resolves `DEFENDER_WINS` at creation.
  - A global pause on GIWA's SuperchainConfig still pauses the portal and the `SystemConfig` through the ETHLockbox identifier.
  - The Guardian can still blacklist a game on the 4.0.0 `AnchorStateRegistry`.
- **Facilitation.** As in sep/124, `approve` needs an explicit `TENDERLY_GAS` because forge's own gas estimate leaves the inner Safe call short of gas (`GS013`). README.md has the commands.

GIWA operates and signs this task itself, and the GIWA team will facilitate `approve` / `execute`. We plan to execute on 2026-11-30 and won't send any other transaction from these three Safes before then, so the pinned nonces (14 / 2 / 3) stay valid.
